Class ClientModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.network.client.ClientModel
public class ClientModel extends Object
Client-side model that holds the local replica of the game state (ClientGameState) and notifies registered observers whenever the state changes. It receives an initial GameSnapshot on join/reconnect and incremental GameDelta updates throughout the game.

This is the connection between the network layer (which receives deltas) and the view layer, which renders the state.
